answer.rationale: The incumbent has refused repricing, so renewal or negotiation is unlikely to meet the 18% component-spend reduction. The archived low-cost vendor record supports a potentially large TCO improvement with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, while the second-source record highlights the delivery-risk exposure created by relying on one supplier. I would verify both records and begin with a guarded transition rather than a broad rollout because the line is already at 94% of committed volume and there is no buffer.
